criteria.text: Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($2,100,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Delamere Marine Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Flags the 30-day vs 45-day notice-period inconsistency between the SPA and the escrow agreement.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
